harness.name: AgentArk SimpleAgent
harness.backend_role: All backends supply model access inside the AgentArk SimpleAgent evaluation loop.
harness.configuration_scope: Actual reasoning, budget exceptions, harness revisions and trajectory limits are reported per model.

target.title: A Pelican Riding a Bicycle
target.instruction: Paint a pelican riding a bicycle.

protocol.context_management: Experience carries across rounds through SimpleAgent's managed context, summaries, and archives. Model weights remain fixed.

quality.note: No Pelican quality scores or author ordering have been supplied. Submission reward is a save/submission-integrity check, not an artistic-quality metric. The model list is a presentation order, not a ranking.
